City Watch: The Lantern Files - fight sounds

All recordings, all CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
Cut, sometimes layered two at a time, levelled and faded with tools/make-fight-sounds.py
(crossbow: tools/make-crossbow-sounds.py). A few are pitched down slightly. Nothing is
synthesised.

punch-1..4     "Punch" (qubodupPunch02-05) - qubodup
               https://opengameart.org/content/punch
heavy-1..2     "37 hits/punches" (hit08, hit02; pitched down 3 semitones) - Independent.nu
               https://opengameart.org/content/37-hitspunches
               over "12 wet towel hitting/falling/punching floor sounds" (03, 10) - qubodup
               https://opengameart.org/content/12-wet-towel-hittingfallingpunching-floor-sounds
club-1..3      "Thwack Sounds" (thwack-02, -05, -06) - AntumDeluge
               https://opengameart.org/content/thwack-sounds
               with qubodup's "Punch" under them
blade-1..2     "Katana Swing" - Still North Media (Ben Jaszczak & Brian Nelson), from
               "Medieval sound effects - Weapon Textures"
               https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-sound-effects-weapon-textures
               then "Thwack Sounds" (thwack-07) / "Punch" (qubodupPunch01)
swish-1..3     "Katana Swing" - Still North Media
block-1..2     "Axe Spear Haft on Haft" - Still North Media, from
               "Medieval sound effects - Weapon Impacts"
               https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-sound-effects-weapon-impacts
guard-1        "Cloth movement 2" - OwlishMedia
               https://opengameart.org/content/202-more-sound-effects
               and "Hammer on wood" - rubberduck
               https://opengameart.org/content/100-cc0-metal-and-wood-sfx
shove-1..2     "Cloth movement 2, 6" - OwlishMedia, with qubodup's wet towel (05, 08)
fall-1..2      "Cloth movement 6, 3" - OwlishMedia, qubodup's wet towel (10, 07) and
               Independent.nu's hit02 / hit07 (pitched down 4 semitones, low-passed)
bolt-1..2      "75 CC0 breaking/falling/hit sfx" (bfh1_hit_07, bfh1_hit_02) - rubberduck
               https://opengameart.org/content/75-cc0-breaking-falling-hit-sfx
spell-1        "Magic spell SFX" (magical_3) - JaggedStone
               https://opengameart.org/content/magic-spell-sfx
grit-1         "Katana Swing" (quiet) - Still North Media, with rubberduck's
               bfh1_rock_falling_04 and _07
bandage-1      "Cloth movement 1" - OwlishMedia
crossbow-1..3  "Crossbow Shoot", with a faint "Crossbow Bolt Pass" - Still North Media,
               from "Medieval sound effects - Weapon Textures"

What plays when:
punch     a fist landing (suspects, empty-hand force)
heavy     a troll's heavy swing landing
club      a truncheon blow
blade     a sword strike (flat of the blade)
swish     a swing that misses
block     a blow taken on Guard
guard     taking up Guard
shove     a shove
fall      someone going down
crossbow  a crossbow shot; bolt the bolt landing
spell     a rogue wizard's dazzle
grit      thrown grit
bandage   a bandage
